description: This file contains a Java class 'ContentJsonEvents' which provides static methods for handling content-related JSON events in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving content associations, moving content, and deleting content, with operations involving database queries, transaction management, and HTTP request/response handling.

classes.name: ContentJsonEvents
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for handling content associations and manipulations via JSON in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getContentAssocs
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts content associations related to a specific content ID, writing the JSON response.

methods.name: moveContent
methods.description: Moves a content association from one content ID to another within a transaction, returning the updated association as JSON.

methods.name: deleteContent
methods.description: Deletes all associations and related web path aliases for a given content ID.

methods.name: deleteContent (overload)
methods.description: Deletes content associations and web path aliases for a specific content ID, updating their 'thruDate' to mark deletion.

methods.name: deleteWebPathAliases
methods.description: Deletes (marks as 'thruDate') all web path aliases and nested associations for a content ID.

methods.name: getTreeNode
methods.description: Builds a JSON node representing a content association, including content name, IDs, and related attributes.
